articles.title: Coloplast down 4% as UBS sees limited upside after guidance cut
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Coloplast (CSE:COLOb) shares fell over 4% on Friday after UBS downgraded the Danish chronic care products maker to "neutral" from "buy", saying its valuation leaves little room for further upside following cuts to its medium-term growth and margin targets.

articles.title: Coloplast (CPSE:COLO B) FY Results Clash With Kerecis Impairment
articles.summary: Coloplast just walked into earnings season with the stock at DKK495.7, capping a strong 30‑day run of about 20% that priced in a lot of optimism. The Q4 2026 print delivered solid healthcare basics, with organic revenue up 6% for the full year and an EBIT margin before special items at 26%. However, the headline was a DKK3.2b impairment linked to Kerecis that dragged reported profit. In the short term, that kind of charge can affect market reaction in a medtech stock. articles.summary: Investing.com -- Coloplast on Tuesday reported fourth-quarter earnings that missed profit expectations and revised its outlook, sending shares about 3% following the announcement.
